newsitem.title: USA: Lifetime Hoan sees higher Q4 shr.
newsitem.headline: Lifetime Hoan sees higher Q4 shr.

text.p: Lifetime Hoan Corp said Wednesday preliminary results for the fourth quarter showed earnings per share between $0.30 and $0.31 against $0.15 a year ago.

The company said net sales for the quarter rose by about 37 percent, compared with $24.2 million for the same period last year. Net income was about twice the $1.8 million in the comparable 1995 quarter, it said.
Per share data reflected a 10-percent stock dividend paid in December 1995, it said.

"Our joint venture acquisition of the assets of Farberware Inc, as well as our acquisition of the Hoffritz trade name, were important factors in this success," it said. The company, which maker household cutlery, said it allocated an additional $8.0 million to its capital expenditure budget for 1997.
